title: 附魔食物
description: Food compatibility, durability, and experience repair enchantments are now available! There's also an enchantment called "Flexible Eating."
body:
As the name suggests, now you can enchant food, including **potions and some special foods**!

Use a piece of food and process it on the **anvil** using the available spellbook.

The enchantment book can be **unbreaking** and **Mending** and a **completely new enchantment**

Unbreaking and Mending can make food more durable and restore its durability.

The newly added enchantment is "Flexible Eating", and it can be obtained through normal means in the survival mode.

Eating food with this enchantment will **result in faster eating speed**, but the **fullness and saturation levels, as well as the duration of the effect**, will be reduced accordingly.

![Durable enchanted purple fruit on the anvil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b3dfa1ed88dcca9fb0c2c35eb890caaec33f6e0.png)


<details>
<summary>Module Background</summary>
Gold has a strong attraction to magic. This can be seen from the fact that the enchantment ability of gold-made tools is so powerful. That's why, as time goes by and the magical power of other foods in the ancient ruins fades away, some golden apples have completed the internalization of magic and become enchanted golden apples! Although golden carrots and glowing watermelons are also made of gold, they are merely composed of a small amount of gold particles.
</details>
